(base/'local-guards.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
(base/'workflow.diff.txt').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--',str(p)]))
print(json.dumps({'diff':'EXACT','yaml':'PASS_COMMAND_EQUIVALENT','data_guard':data['status'],'phase_scope':scope['status'],'experimental_opens':0}))
